antarctic-treaty|nato: Antarctica's treaty flag and NATO are both dark blue with white lines running across them. Antarctica's has a white map of the continent in a grid of latitude and longitude lines; NATO's has a compass rose in a ring with four lines running to the edges.
antarctic-treaty|un: Antarctica's treaty flag and the UN both show a white polar map on blue. The UN is light blue with the whole world framed by olive branches; Antarctica's flag is dark blue with only the frozen continent under a grid of lines.
arab-league|gcc: The GCC and the Arab League are both green with a round emblem in the center. The GCC's emblem is a black ring of script around a map of the Arabian Peninsula in a hexagon; the Arab League's is a white crescent inside a gold chain and laurel wreath.
arab-league|sa: The Arab League and Saudi Arabia are both green flags with white Arabic script. The Arab League's script sits above a crescent inside a chain and laurel wreath in the center; Saudi Arabia has a line of script over a horizontal sword and no wreath.
ch|red-cross: Switzerland and the Red Cross use the same cross in reversed colors. Switzerland is a white cross on a square red flag; the Red Cross is a red cross on a white field.
cv|eu: The European Union and Cape Verde both have a ring of gold stars on blue. The EU has twelve stars on plain blue in the center; Cape Verde has ten stars set towards the hoist over white and red stripes.
francophonie|olympics: The Francophonie and the Olympic flag are both white with five colored circles or arcs. The Olympics have five whole interlocking rings in two rows; the Francophonie has a single ring broken into five colored arcs.
oas|un: The UN and the OAS are both blue with a white emblem in the center. The UN is light blue with a plain white world map in olive branches; the OAS is a deeper blue with a white disc full of colorful member flags.
olympics|paralympics: The Olympic and Paralympic flags are both white with colored symbols in the center. The Olympics have five interlocking rings; the Paralympics have three swooshes in red, blue and green.
red-crescent|red-crystal: The Red Crystal and the Red Crescent are both a single red emblem on white. The Red Crescent is a curved crescent; the Red Crystal is a hollow square stood on its corner like a diamond.
red-crescent|tr: The Red Crescent and Turkey both show a crescent opening towards the fly. The Red Crescent is a red crescent alone on white; Turkey is a white crescent and star on red.
red-cross|red-crystal: The Red Crystal and the Red Cross are both a single red emblem on white. The Red Cross is a solid cross; the Red Crystal is a hollow diamond-shaped frame.
so|un: The UN and Somalia are both light blue with a white emblem in the center. Somalia has a single white five-pointed star; the UN has a world map framed by olive branches.
un|who: WHO and the UN are both light blue with the white UN emblem of a world map in olive branches. WHO adds a gold staff with a snake coiled round it, standing up through the middle; the UN's emblem is plain white.
